title: The Refresh Test
document_title: Agent Field Notes No. 001 — The Refresh Test

source.name: GitHub Changelog
source.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
source.section: Let Copilot work in your browser

verified_facts: Browser use is in public preview for the GitHub Copilot app.
Works in Chromium-based browsers, including Chrome and Edge, with the GitHub Copilot extension, in an isolated tab group.
Off by default; enable both Enable Computer Use and Enable Browser Use under Settings > Computer Use.
Docs (gh.io/about-browser-use): Edge also needs Google Chrome installed.
must_include: Use test data. There’s no need to place an order.
In my local shop, add one mug and one notebook to the cart.
List the item names and quantities. Refresh the page once. List the names and quantities again.
Report any difference. Don’t check out or change the code.
Wait, but are they the same two items?
If they change on refresh, capture the failure in a regression test.
